template.helpTitle: How to fill in this file

help.h1: One customer per row. Keep the first row (the column names) as it is.
help.h2: Name and Mobile are required. Mobile: a 10-digit Indian number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9 (+91 or a leading 0 is fine).
help.h4: Department: its name exactly as in the app. Unknown departments are left empty.
help.h5: Assigned salesperson: their mobile number. If it is empty or unknown, the customer goes to the person importing.
help.h6: WhatsApp consent: Yes only if the customer agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from the store.
help.h7: At most {max} rows per file. The same mobile twice in one file is a mistake; a customer already saved is shown before anything is imported.
